name: Sequential Thinking MCP Server
what: An official MCP reference server with one tool, sequential_thinking, that lets the model work through a problem as numbered steps. It can revise earlier steps, branch into alternatives and change how many steps it plans as it goes.
who: People who want the agent to plan out a tricky design or debugging task step by step before it acts.

setup.text: Add to your MCP client config:
Or add it from the Codex CLI:
On Windows, launch npx through cmd /c (the README shows the exact config).

prompts: Use sequential thinking to plan a migration from REST to tRPC for this app.
Think step by step about why this test is flaky before changing any code.
Break down how to add multiplayer to this game into ordered steps, revising as needed.
